messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're publishing SDK v1.0 and deprecating v0.9. Full docs refresh and migration guide is live: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 and deployed under /sdk/migrate-v1.

maya: timeline?

alex: TL;DR: v0.9 is marked 'deprecated' today. Security fixes only for 90 days. EoL (no fixes) in ~90 days after that. Please aim to upgrade to v1.0 by 2026-04-01 for a smooth rollout.

sanjay: any breaking changes we should call out in the changelog?

alex: Yes — two common gotchas to flag in release notes and the migration checklist:
1) Import path change: `from redwood import Client` -> `from redwood.client import RedwoodClient`
2) Streaming API behavior: streaming now exposes an async generator instead of a push-style callback. Example migration snippet: 
```
# old (sync/callback style)
client = Client(api_key)
resp = client.generate(prompt)
# new (async generator)
from redwood.client import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key)
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(prompt):
    print(chunk)
```

sarah: Package name stays the same (redwood-sdk)? any env var changes?

devrel-bot: release published: redwood-sdk v1.0.0 on PyPI — https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/1.0.0 :tada:

alex: Correct — PyPI package is `redwood-sdk`. We did bump minimum Python to 3.9. Also renaming a token env var: old REDWOOD_API_KEY is now deprecated in favor of RW_API_KEY. For now v1.0 will read REDWOOD_API_KEY for compatibility but logs will warn.

maya: Can docs team add a short upgrade checklist for customers (one-liner steps)?

alex: Already added in the PR: short checklist, code snippets, and an "if you can't upgrade yet" section (pin legacy model variants and routing policy example). PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

sanjay: I'll prep support KB and a quick triage flow for common errors (import errors, async vs sync issues).

sarah: I'll draft release notes + customer-facing email.

docs-bot: docs site updated: /sdk/ v1.0 + migration guide deployed. CDN cache purge scheduled for 10:30 UTC.

alex: Action items: @sarah prepare release notes and customer email; @sanjay write support KB and canned replies; @maya publish the upgrade checklist on the community forum and pin it. We'll follow up with a short migration webinar next week. Thanks all! :rocket:
